subject: Plan simplification and feature bundling for ClearLine optimization
messages:
From: Sarah Jennings <sarah@clearlinehealth.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Plan simplification / feature bundle question

Hi Chloe,

We're evaluating a move from the Growth tier down to Compact for next quarter to save on monthly run costs, but there are a few feature constraints we can't accept losing:
- Priority burst for scheduled batch inference (up to 2x throughput for short windows)
- Prefix/KV caching for real-time session continuity
- Per-route observability (basic traces and latency buckets)

Before we start an internal approval, can you confirm:
1) Whether those features are available as addons on Compact (and their monthly cost)
2) If we take a 12-month term on Compact with a 20% seat reduction, what discount level you'd be able to offer (we have an active PO cycle in early April)
3) Any migration caveats (billing/proration, feature parity windows) we should plan for

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if it's easier.

—Sarah
Sarah Jennings
Director, ML Platform
ClearLine Health
From: chloe_martin@redwood.com
To: Sarah Jennings <sarah@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Plan simplification / feature bundle question

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers up front, then a suggested next step: 

1) Feature availability: Compact + Addons can cover everything you listed. We offer: 
   • Priority Burst (addon): priced as a monthly reserved burst pool (up to 2x) — typical list $2,500/mo for the burst pool you described.
   • KV/Prefix caching: included as a lightweight addon (list $850/mo) when pairing Compact with our cache license.
   • Per-route observability (basic): available as an observability-lite addon ($450/mo).

2) Discounting: For a 12-month commitment with the seat reduction you described, we can consider a volume discount. I'll need to confirm with pricing (copying Ben & Kimberly). Preliminary: we can offer up to 18% off list for Compact + those three addons if the term and payment cadence align.

3) Migration caveats: 
   • Billing: prorated credit for the remainder of the current Growth month; new Compact invoice starts at effective date.
   • Feature parity: KV cache will be feature-equivalent but cache warm-up may impact headroom for 24–48 hours.
   • SLA/throughput: Compact with burst pool preserves peak throughput but sustained throughput is lower than Growth; recommend a 2-week staged traffic cutover.

Next step: If that looks acceptable, can you send a preferred contract effective date and whether ClearLine wants invoices monthly or upfront? If yes, I’ll run final pricing and send a redline-ready term sheet.

Best,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com; Sarah Jennings <sarah@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Plan simplification / feature bundle question

Sarah/Chloe — quick engineering note on the Compact + burst setup:

- Burst pool: we recommend reserving the burst pool for scheduled batch windows only (cron-triggered jobs) to avoid noisy-neighbor impact on real-time sessions. Implementation is trivial — we can gate with a pass-through header and routing policy.
- KV cache: if you rely heavily on long-lived sessions (>30s average), increase the cache slot allocation by 25% on day 1 to avoid misses during warm-up.
- Observability: observability-lite will include route-level latency histograms (1s/5s/10s buckets) but not full traces — if you need traces for the first 30 days of cutover we can enable a temporary trial of the full observability suite.

Happy to run a 30-minute runbook session with your infra folks; I can demo the cutover pattern.

—Ben
Principal Sales Engineer

Hi all — I've reviewed pricing and approvals for CL-8742. We can do the following concession structure to close this cycle: 

1) Compact base tier: 15% off list with 12-month term, monthly invoicing.
2) Addons (Burst pool, KV cache, Observability-lite): combined addon bundle at 18% off list if purchased together.
3) One-time migration credit: $6,000 applied to the first invoice to cover engineering support during the staged cutover.

Conditions: Payment terms net-30. This package requires signature on the attached term sheet by 2027-04-10 to guarantee pricing and the migration credit. 

I've attached the term sheet and a suggested pricing model (.xlsx) with line items and the net ARR calculation. Chloe — please confirm if we should allow monthly invoicing (Sarah requested) or push for upfront quarterly to improve cost of sale.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
